class BranchBase { constructor(public n: number = 0) {} }
class BranchChild extends BranchBase {
  constructor(flag: boolean, public value: number) {
    if (flag) super(1); else super(2);
    console.log(this.n, this.value);
  }
}
new BranchChild(true, 9);
new BranchChild(false, 8);
class BlockChild extends BranchBase {
  constructor(public value: number) {
    { const value = 90; super(value); console.log(this.value); }
    console.log(this.n, this.value);
  }
}
new BlockChild(7);
class ReturningChild extends BranchBase {
  constructor(public value: number) { return super(4) as unknown as ReturningChild; }
}
console.log(new ReturningChild(5));
